annotations.text: Landscape, and the screen is a scene rather than a UI — the day is a calendar on the wall, the timer is a sign, the ingredients are trays on a real counter. The station and the shop are live: tap the dough tray, press it flat on the board, spread zaatar or cheese, drop it on the saj, pull it inside the green band, hand it over, then tap the coins.
What the landscape layout is actually solving: read above the counter line, touch below it, and the pipeline runs left to right the way a baker works.
